_what: The categories a person scores replies against. Fixed in a file so they are chosen before a reading rather than during one, and so the tool and M-11-step02-categories.md cannot drift.
_why_a_person: R10's ruled subject was the machine's condition OR the child's situation. Three detectors were written for the second and all three failed against a reader — 31% disagreement in M-11 step 02, 47% in step 04, and 0 of 10 against 5 of 10 in step 05a. The claim is carried by an adverb, a modal or a bare imperative, and all seven R10 families match propositions.

axis3: asserts progress the child has not claimed

_axis3: Added in M-11 step 06, from step 05a. Step 04 measured 'contradicts the child' at 0 of 70, and that axis requires the child to have SAID the thing being denied. A cold start at chapter 11 was told 'you've woken the machine up' having said nothing about it — 2 of 5 — which BE forbids and axis2 cannot see. The zero was real and narrower than it read.
_sets: Named category sets. `axes` is M-11's, for what a reply does about the child's position. `placing` is M-12's, for what a reply does with a description of a board. read_replies.py takes --set and defaults to `axes`, so M-11's readings are unaffected.
_placing_axis1: What the reply does. `places to a board state` means it names or hedges across the set the description actually supports — *you're somewhere around the creature or the sabotage chapter* — rather than choosing one. `teaches` is BK: explaining what a part is, in the course of finding out whether the child has it.
_placing_axis2: Whether the placing is right AGAINST WHAT THE CHILD DESCRIBED, not against what the fixture intended — X3. This is the axis the ceiling makes necessary. Seven of the fourteen chapters share a board with others, so a description of the 18-part board supports 10, 11, 12 and G equally. **`over-precise` is naming one chapter when the description supports several**, and it is a failure that looks exactly like success: a confident correct-sounding answer that the evidence does not carry.
_placing_axis3: X6 and BK, and it applies only to the two cannot_place descriptions. The failure mode is a loop: Milo asks what is on the board, the child cannot say, and Milo asks again. `TEACH` is the material and has been served since M-11.
